name: Laser Lightshow
storyline:
One Laser.
That's all it starts with.

Bounce it off a mirror. Hit a target. Easy. You've seen that before.

That's where the similarities end... because then you are handed more. A whole lot more.

Prisms. Teleporters. Rotating machinery. Colored glass. Paint. Tracks. Sonic blasters. Wires. Logic gates. Repeaters. Pressure plates. Interfaces. Suddenly you're not just solving puzzles—you’re reverse engineering ridiculous machines, triggering massive chain reactions, and filling the screen with lasers, sparks, explosions, and light.

Every new mechanic is designed to combine with everything that came before it, creating hundreds of handcrafted puzzles packed with satisfying "Aha!" moments and spectacular solutions.

This is a platform for awesome puzzles and limitless possibilities.

Then Build Your Own.
The built-in editor isn't an afterthought.

It's the same editor used to build the entire game.

Want to make a clever five-second puzzle? Go for it.

Want to build an absurd laser-powered machine that takes thirty seconds to unfold before ending in a screen full of lightning and chaos? You can do that too.

With dozens of mechanics that all interact with one another, the possibilities grow astronomically. Design elegant puzzles, elaborate contraptions, functioning logic circuits, or things that exist simply because they're fun to watch.

Features
Hundreds of handcrafted campaign puzzles

Dozens of unique mechanics that combine in surprising ways

Bright, flashy visuals filled with lasers, explosions, sparks, and satisfying effects

A full-featured level editor included with the game

Create everything from tiny brainteasers to enormous mechanical masterpieces

Share your creations across Steam and mobile— and earn creator points and unlockables whenever the community plays your levels!

Multiple music styles to match every mood

Secrets, optional challenges, and plenty of "Wait... that actually works?"

Whether you're solving puzzles or inventing your own, Laser Lightshow is all about one thing:

Giving you more toys than you know what to do with... and then watching what you build.
summary: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.
